sources.title: David Tong, Statistical Physics, author-hosted full lecture notes

contents.support: The source supplies statistical-mechanical conventions; the local lemma proves the countable trace, domains, and independent marginals under explicit hypotheses.

contents.support: The source gives the standard critical-density route; the local argument supplies missing-origin control and proves the fixed-mean-density sequence and grand fluctuation limit.

contents.name: Two-mode canonical versus grand preparation comparison

contents.name: Grand-condensate fluctuation qualification
contents.support: The source motivates the ensemble distinction; the local example derives the macroscopic variance and tail from the geometric law.
